description: A flat color picker that combines the color gradient, palette, and preview in a single panel.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Whether to show the clear button in the palette. Default true.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: Event fired when the color value changes.

parameters.name: PaletteColors
parameters.description: Whether to show the color palette. Default true.

parameters.name: PaletteColumns
parameters.description: Predefined colors to display in the palette.

parameters.name: ShowClearButton
parameters.description: Whether to show the preview row. Default true.

parameters.name: ShowGradient
parameters.description: Whether to show the alpha channel. Default true.

parameters.name: ShowHexInput
parameters.description: Whether to show the gradient color area. Default true.

parameters.name: ShowPalette
parameters.description: Whether to show the hex color input. Default true.

parameters.name: ShowPreview
parameters.description: Number of columns in the palette grid. Default 8.
